title: WaterSound Compass Point II-101 - 37 Compass Pt. Way
h1: WaterSound Compass Point II-101 - 37 Compass Pt. Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf Front- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 1 designated parking space. This condo permits a maximum of 1 vehicle through the community security gate.DETAILS: 101 Compass Point 2 is a sensational gulf front condo with phenomenal views of the Gulf of Mexico, making this an unforgettable vacation location! This spacious 4 bedroom 4.5 bath condo in WaterSound is sure to please! With its heart-stopping views and its terrific location, this will be your perfect vacation retreat! On the first floor, you will find one queen bedroom and one king bedroom, both with connecting bathrooms with a single vanity and glass shower. There is a bedroom with one queen-over-queen bunk bed on this floor that has a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and a tub & shower combination. You can access the balcony by all of these bedrooms. Also, you will encounter an office area and the washer and dryer on this floor as well. When entering the second floor, you will be welcomed by the soothing great room with its warm tones, high ceilings, gorgeous hardwood floors and spectacular views! You will also be able to enjoy meals from the home's beautiful kitchen! There, you will experience the high end appliances, granite countertops and stunning cabinetry. This kitchen has all of the items needed to prepare that delicious meal! There is enough room for everyone to enjoy after a fun-filled day at the beach. What a perfect end to a perfect day! Next, you will encounter the primary king bedroom with an attached bathroom that has a double vanity, a jetted tub and glass shower. It has a walk-in closet and balcony access where you will be able to see the emerald coast! This condo has substantial indoor and outdoor space, which makes for a truly great gathering spots for everyone to spend time together, making a memorable vacation! This magnificent WaterSound condo is simply stunning and gives you the serenity you have been craving and it is all here at one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12) FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Additional Living Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.Low-Speed Vehicles: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW. - Unfortunately due to HOA rules the guest will not be able to rent golf carts and will not be able to bring their own golf cart.- If the home you are renting has a golf cart provided by the owner then please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations. - If we have not received the proper insurance and driver's license information then YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO USE THE GOLF CART. - Lastly, if a person without a valid driver's license is found to have operated the golf cart provided, or is found driving in a reckless manner then the guest will be fined a $750.00 charge.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
